Meyer, in l. cf. also JThS, July, 1909, April, 1911; MM, s.v.). 2. Passively = (, of a lion's prey, טֶרֶף), a thing seized, hence, a prize: RV. The lexical data favour the active meaning, but as they also admit the possibility of the alternative, most modern expositors have accepted the latter as seeming to suit the logic of the passage better.
